majorIds.Fallout: Bomb Arrow gains +7.5 area, +50%, severely increased recoil, and 25% self-damage.

before.lore: Mysterious runes, held by inexplicable ancient guardians, were once moulded together for study purposes. The experiment went awry, as the runic words Nii, Az, and Ek were combined in a reaction that resulted in the collapse of a civilization.

after.lore: This expertly crafted relik was notched by a cryptid-researching fanatic. Its feathers and baubles chime with a soothing melody.

majorIds.Fission: Explosions from your Exploding ID are twice as big and twice as strong.

before.lore: Watch as they receive your gift of imminent disaster and endless fallout.

before.lore: Ancient scholars claim the malevolent fungus within its plates feeds on the host's life force, granting unspeakable toxic power in return. Yet every wearer risks wasting away from the inside out.

after.lore: Ancient scholars claim the malevolent fungus within its plates feeds on the host's life force, granting unspeakable toxic power in return. Yet every wearer risks wasting away from the inside out.

majorIds.Molten Rebirth: Harvester additionally restores 1.5% health per leftover mark, increasing to 3% with devour.

add.lore: The Dogun God Garaheth was actually an immense fire demon occupying the bowels of Molten Heights. Although unwise, the Dwarves forged a demonic dagger using his tooth in celebration of his slaughter.

majorIds.Thunderous Strike: Fireworks additionally summons a lightning bolt, dealing 80% and 40% while stunning enemies for 0.8s.

add.lore: The raw aspect of thunder, though claimed to be harnessed by a mage in a wand, has only been truly tamed by this mighty blade. Combined electric and life-draining magic intertwine and bring forth the truest, most frightening power of all Thunder.

Fashioned from a single, reddish branch, this spear is adorned with the body of a great salamander, reaching the arm at such an angle to suggest it is but part of a greater mural. The silver tail flares at its wielder's whim, lashing out in a scorching burst, all to ignite anew.
The passage of time, the ending of life, and you.

majorIds.Seeking Totem: Totem moves towards you when wearing Mask of the Heretic.

add.lore: They didn’t follow you this far to watch you survive.
The body must return to the earth. Just as leaves wither in fall, so, too, must we all.

majorIds.Woe's Epithet: Shadow Dance's cooldown is reduced by 0.5s when vanishing and Shadow Siphon immediately refreshes Vanish. Surprise Strike's multiplier is reduced by -30%.

add.lore: Found at the site of the Caritat Mansion, a curse falls upon on all who don this glove; a decay of the body, to fester in their wounds, and a decay of the mind, to muddle all thought. With it, a notion takes hold: to suffer together is to suffer no more.

majorIds.Negation: Your next spell after leaving Vanish is free (2 second cooldown).

add.lore: This sacrificial kris, fallen from the peak of the Tower of Ascension, is completely hollow. To wield it is to invite to yourself the same hollowness. To become such an aberration, to unwrite yourself in pursuit of power...it must be fed of its wielder til only the barest existence remains.

majorIds.Galvanized: While Eldritch Call is active, Blood Connection can be used much further from your Totem.

add.lore: The unfortunate product of a Corkian electromage trying to fuse avo lifeblood into an iron band

majorIds.Seeking Totem: Totem moves towards you when wearing Mask of the Heretic.

add.lore: A traditional piece to celebrate worship of the bovine. The cuff is lined with leather.
A piece of stellar armor, awarded often to Ragni's best in celebration after accomplishments of grandeur.

A curious dagger, with an ornate, gnarled hilt that feels ancient to the touch. The carvings seem like an offering of sorts, though whether an act of worship, peace, or surrender may be lost to the winds of time. And yet, the blade gleams as if forged just yesterday, its inscription reading, We bode you well.

The allure of power over the desert winds, of stares of fearful respect, of immortality in name and body... It was a deep yearning that drew Hashr to the land of his forefathers, chasing rumors of new, unparalleled elemental magicks.
You're suffocating in this static, fighting against the cutting winds. Without that familiar warmth to guide you... you're tripping. stumbling, drowning - lost, all alone in the snow.

majorIds.Immortal Rot: For every 1% of health missing, dodging with agility ignores 0.2% more damage.

add.lore: The very first crossbow in existence was claimed to be utterly indestructible, but it is only true to a fault. The item cannot be broken, but solely because all damage to it is instead reflected onto the user. As its age is uncountably ancient, wielders will find themselves rapidly aging and withering away with even a mere touch.
Smooth the water until not a single ripple gives away what drowned beneath. Such is the peace Her Majesty bestowed upon the Province.
One should always strive to go boldly, even where many have gone before.

majorIds.Fractured Halo: Ophanim gains +4 orbs, no longer increases mana cost and has increased fire speed, but shatters immediately upon contact.

add.lore: In your divine grace, forgive those who are weak. In your divine power, smite those who stray from your rightful path. In your divine mercy, save us.
A message in death-rattle poems and doomsday graffiti: the blaspheme camorras will all have their day. This helmet sings secrets and whispers prediction: no prisons, no idols can keep her contained.

It is said that a lost tribe of the jungle sought to grow a tree of their own as they founded a settlement, commemorating each new year with a single band carved intricately into it's lowest-hanging branch. Even as a great storm uprooted the trunk, the tradition wore on until their quiet collapse, nearly six hundred bands telling the tale of a tribe that once was.
A carapace of organic matter which latches to the head of it's host. Eyewitnesses report victims throwing dizzied blows with staggering power while constantly emitting muffled screams.

majorIds.Myriad Salvo: Mirror Image gains +1 clone and casts all damage spells with Last Laugh, but losing a Mirror Clone slays all Mirror Clones simultaneously.

add.lore: To be outnumbered is a terrible thing, indeed.
An aged, Olmic artifact, with a watch set within the metal. The minute hand is exactly one minute behind.

This wand's construction is exceedingly basic, even compared to starter wands by today's standards. Despite being seemingly centuries old, it's freezing to the touch...which writes impressive conclusions about its apparent wielder.

Hashr returned with singleminded belief, determined to keep the howling winds at bay from a usurped throne. Yet the storms raged on. The awe of his countrymen festered to hatred, and the blessing of his predecessor withered to a curse, the desert sands naught but grains in an hourglass so cruelly fused shut.
